name: COMP_045
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (83%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Benign [F1] on this simulated frozen section with positive margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 83%, Benign 7%, Normal 6%, Invasive 4% | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target; 90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate InSitu from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD (12 tiles; AUROC 70%) [F6] | Atypical OOD distance; unflagged quality |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (same top class) | Independent models agree with each other |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (83–88%); Benign contrast 83% [F5] | Neighbors match; Benign contrast close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 3, 7) · context · lowers invasive score (-0.83) [F2]; 8/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · lowers invasive score (-0.47) [F3]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · lowers invasive score (-0.46) [F4]; text-only, caption-inconsistent (18/20) · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · raises invasive score (+0.46); 3/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · lowers invasive score (-0.27); 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is Benign: stays in 90% conformal set and matches contrast case BACH_0305 (83% similarity).
- Focal invasion exists in region 11 (50% risk), with cells disabled and deeper levels needed.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 2, 8**: inspect highest-risk tiles (50%, 7%, 4% risk) to exclude invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 8, 9**: verify InSitu vs Benign tubules/lobules; consider deeper levels (stains blocked).
3. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 8, 10, 11**: check superior (430 um), lateral (538 um), and inferior (108 um) margins.

found: 'Gland / tubule formation' is tagged Validated but should be Weak (spot check 18/20, caption check failed).
The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
